title: Annotatio III §.X (1): Adversatur Scripture — Institution antithesis; Hottinger’s dozen-plus
pass_a_gloss: For Transsubstantiation is adverse (1) to Holy Scripture, whose authority overthrows this fiction both elsewhere and most of all in that place where the Institution of this Sacrament is handed down — which Blessed Hottinger, distinguished light of the Reformed Church, makes emerge most manifestly from an antithesis more numerous than a dozen, Defense of the Eucharist Sect. VIII from p. 79 to 84.
pass_b_english: (1) It is adverse to Holy Scripture — overthrown elsewhere and above all where the Sacrament’s Institution is given.
Hottinger (Eucharist Defense VIII, pp. 79–84) shows that from an antithesis denser than a dozen.
source_text: Enimvero Transsubstantiatio adversatur (1) Scripturæ S. cujus autoritas hoc commentum tùm alibi evertit, tùm eô maximè loco, ubi Sacramenti hujus Institutio traditur, id quod ex Antithesi, duodenaria numerosiori, manifestissimè emergere facit insigne Ecclesiæ Reformatæ lumen B. Hottingerus Eucharistiæ defens. Sect. VIII. à p. m. 79. ad 84.

lemmas.gloss: an antithesis more numerous than a dozen
